svg.title: Stracer backend request flow
svg.desc: A client request passes through middleware, endpoint security, controller and business logic, data access, and response serialization. Security failures can return early.
svg.text: Backend request → response flow
Typical protected API request; endpoint requirements determine which checks apply.
1. Client sends an HTTPS request
Portal cookie or machine API credentials, plus request data
2. Transport, routing, and session middleware
Forwarded / security headers, HTTPS, routing, CORS, cookies, session
Static files and route rewriting can handle special paths earlier.
3. Authenticate and enforce security
Cookie authentication → region → rate limit → CSRF → authorization
Endpoint filters validate Python / RF API keys where required.
Early response
4. Execute controller and business logic
Validate input, user/company scope, license, and requested operation
5. Read or write data
Redis when applicable; regional MySQL via EF Core / Dapper / SQL
Use S3 for supported files; persist jobs for background processing.
6. Build the response
Serialize JSON or return a downloadable file / MVC response
7. Client receives the result
Update dashboard, display status, or download the report
Long-running reports: accept upload → worker processes job → client checks status / downloads output.
Request order is based on Program.cs and the endpoint security filters.
